points.label: Forgiveness setting and claim
points.left: At the meal Jesus identifies covenant blood poured out for many for remission of sins and looks toward a future kingdom drink.
points.right: John’s wilderness baptism is described as repentance for forgiveness of sins before the stronger coming one is announced.
